entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I assist you today?
Hi, Sarah... I'm calling because I need to return my VeloBand Pulse. I'm just... I'm so disappointed this didn't work out.
Oh, I'm certainly sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into the return options for you. First, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's not broken or anything... honestly, I haven't even had a chance to use it. We had a sudden family emergency. My father-in-law was rushed to the hospital and needed major surgery. It's been a nightmare.
I am so incredibly sorry to hear about your family's situation. That sounds terribly stressful. Let me see what I can do for you. Do you have your order number handy?

Yes, it's VF-8675309. It's just been one thing after another. My brother is also in the military and just got news of a surprise deployment, so we've been helping his family get ready. I feel awful even calling about this, but I really needed this money back.

Please, don't feel awful at all. Family absolutely comes first. Thank you for that number... Okay, I'm pulling up your order now. I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered on December 15th, so about 40 days ago.
Let me just double-check our return policy... Okay, great news. I see here that all our items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery. So you are unfortunately outside the timeframe.
Oh, really? Ninety days? Oh, thank goodness. That's such a huge relief. You have no idea.

Yes, absolutely. We can get this processed for you right away. I am emailing you a pre-paid return shipping label as we speak. Just place the VeloBand back in its original packaging, affix the label, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Thank you, thank you so much, Sarah. I was so worried. You've really helped me out today.
It is my pleasure. I'm happy I could make things a little easier for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that was everything. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope things get better for you and your family soon. Have a good day.
